description: Scenarios observed_call_arguments may replay. Each id names an existing, documented concrete scenario; nothing here adds hardware behavior. 'firmware_keys' lists the images whose code the scenario executes; a scenario can only observe a function of an image it executes. Harness assumptions are recorded per run (the boot recipe's disclosed list, or each virtual-link leg's seeds, register seeds, stubs and forced state).

boot.entry_conditions: Reset_Handler on a pristine machine; recipe assumptions applied for the whole run
boot.termination: recipe instruction budget (450,000) or the entry-watch cap

vl-ampersand.entry_conditions: mid-firmware leg entries (RX dispatcher, TX event dispatcher) on non-booted RAM with seeded packet state
vl-ampersand.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-g.entry_conditions: mid-firmware leg entries on non-booted RAM with seeded packet state and stubbed driver helpers
vl-g.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-s.entry_conditions: mid-firmware leg entries on non-booted RAM; device-state bytes seeded to two values
vl-s.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-bang.entry_conditions: mid-firmware leg entries on non-booted RAM, including fresh=False continuations
vl-bang.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-i.entry_conditions: mid-firmware leg entries on non-booted RAM with seeded channel/mode state
vl-i.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-i9i1.entry_conditions: mid-firmware leg entries on non-booted RAM with seeded packet state
vl-i9i1.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-plus.entry_conditions: direct AAPCS calls and leg entries on non-booted RAM with carried and seeded state
vl-plus.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-plus-interactive.entry_conditions: direct AAPCS calls on non-booted RAM with seeded state
vl-plus-interactive.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-manual-f0e0.entry_conditions: mid-firmware leg entries on non-booted RAM with seeded manual-mode records
vl-manual-f0e0.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-pb05.entry_conditions: mid-firmware leg entries on non-booted RAM with a seeded persisted-record buffer
vl-pb05.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound

vl-t-status.entry_conditions: Remote-only legs; executes no AutoPilot code
vl-t-status.termination: each leg's own stop address or instruction bound
